name: Trastuzumab
mechanism: Humanised IgG1 binding HER2 domain IV, inhibiting ligand-independent HER2 signalling and extracellular domain shedding, and mediating antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity. Biosimilars and a subcutaneous formulation are available.
keyToxicities: Cardiotoxicity (left ventricular dysfunction, generally reversible and not cumulative-dose dependent)
monitoring: LVEF assessment at baseline and periodically during treatment
interactions: Cardiotoxicity risk is increased with prior or concurrent anthracyclines.
resistance: Truncated p95HER2 lacking the trastuzumab epitope, PIK3CA mutation/PTEN loss, alternative ErbB ligand-driven signalling and MUC4-mediated epitope masking.
